Palestinian journalist returns home after 15 months in Israeli detention
articles.summary:
Palestinian journalist returns home after 15 months in Israeli detention

Palestinian journalist Farah Abu Ayyash has returned home to her family following 450 days of detention in Israeli prisons, according to a report by the Islamic Republic News Agency (Irna).

Abu Ayyash, a West Bank correspondent for Iran's Tasnim News Agency, was freed on Thursday night after the Ofer Prison military court ordered her release, dismissing the charges brought against her after she served 15 months under administrative detention.

According to Irna, Abu Ayyash was initially detained on 6 August 2025, during an overnight military raid on her family home in Beit Ummar, north of Hebron. The outlet reported that her arrest was tied to her journalistic work covering local developments across the southern West Bank for Tasnim.

The report further noted that repeated procedural delays prolonged her case, keeping her detained without formal resolution under administrative detention at Damon Prison. Irna also reported that the correspondent was allegedly subjected to torture and mistreatment while in custody.

articles.title: Iran warns of 'earth-shattering blow' as Araghchi slams Germany's war stance
articles.summary:
Iran warns of 'earth-shattering blow' as Araghchi slams Germany's war stance

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Aragchi has criticised Germany for supporting Israel-US war on Iran last year and now complaining the conflict has added has added more than 100 billion euros ($112bn) to Europe’s energy costs.

In a post on X, Araghchi said that when Israel-US bombings of Iran began last year, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz  hailed them as "doing Europe's dirty work".

"100bn Euro is nothing compared to the Earth-shattering blow Iran's Powerful Armed Forces will deal against those who dare harm our people," Araghchi said. 

"Red lines are a thing of the past," he added.

articles.title: 'We must be so strong that no dares covet our land', Pezeshkian says
articles.summary:
'We must be so strong that no dares covet our land', Pezeshkian says

Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has reminded his countrymen that “we must be so strong that no one dares to covet our land and identity”.

In a post on X marking forthcoming National Youth Day on 8 November, Pezeshkian recalled the "courage of Mohammad Hossein Fahmideh", a 13-year-old Iranian boy killed during the Iran-Iraq war, and paid tribute to children killed in Minab, Lamerd and other parts of the country.

Pezeshkian said: "The names and memories of our children remain in our minds and shape our collective historical memory, so that we know we must be so strong that no one dares to covet our land and identity."

articles.title: Saudi Arabia suspends travel, entry from Kenya over Ebola concerns
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia on Friday announced additional precautionary measures against the Ebola virus, including suspending travel to and entry from Kenya, according to the Saudi Press Agency (SPA). The measures, introduced following an assessment of the epidemiological situation by health authorities, include suspending travel by Saudi citizens to Kenya and halting the issuance of all types of visas to travelers from the East African country. The kingdom will also prohibit entry to travelers arriving from Kenya, including those traveling through third countries who have stayed in Kenya or other Ebola-affected countries during the 21 days preceding their arrival. Napětí s Íránem nadále eskaluje, což dokazuje odhalení špionáže izraelského vojáka pro Teherán a incidenty v Hormuzském průlivu. Humanitární krize v Gaze a na Západním břehu mezitím prohlubuje regionální nestabilitu.
archive.security_status_en: Israel faces a deep political crisis following an inconclusive election and fraud allegations, while opposition leaders have begun talks to form a government. Tensions with Iran continue to escalate, highlighted by an Israeli soldier charged with spying for Tehran and incidents in the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, the humanitarian crisis in Gaza and the West Bank deepens regional instability.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat intenzivní koaliční manévry v izraelském Knesetu a pokračující právní i politické spory ohledně volebních výsledků. Bezpečnostní složky zůstanou ve vysoké pohotovosti kvůli hrozbám ze strany Íránu.
archive.forecast_en: Intense coalition maneuvering in the Knesset and ongoing legal and political disputes over election results are expected in the coming days. Security forces will remain on high alert due to threats from Iran.

archive.security_status_cs: Izrael čelí hluboké politické patové situaci po nerozhodných volbách a obviněním z vměšování, zatímco Írán vystupňuje napětí zadržením dvou ropných tankerů jižně od Hormuzského průlivu. Sýrie se nadále potýká s ekonomickou krizí a humanitárními dopady po záplavách, a Irák řeší vnitřní bezpečnostní otázky včetně rozsudků nad členy Islámského státu.
archive.security_status_en: Israel is facing a deep political deadlock following inconclusive elections and allegations of interference, while Iran has escalated tensions by detaining two oil tankers south of the Strait of Hormuz. Syria continues to grapple with economic crisis and humanitarian impacts from flash floods, and Iraq is addressing internal security issues including rulings on Islamic State members.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující povolební vyjednávání v Izraeli a diplomatické manévry kolem íránských zásahů proti tankerům v Hormuzském průlivu.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, continued post-election negotiations in Israel and diplomatic maneuvers surrounding Iranian actions against tankers in the Strait of Hormuz are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu zůstává extrémně napjatá kvůli probíhajícímu konfliktu s Íránem, útokům na ropné tankery v Hormuzském průlivu a eskalaci v Libanonu. Izrael se navíc potýká s hlubokou politickou nestabilitou po nerozhodných volbách a pokračující krizí v Gaze.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the region remains extremely tense due to the ongoing conflict with Iran, attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, and escalation in Lebanon. Additionally, Israel is facing deep political instability following inconclusive elections and the ongoing crisis in Gaza.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další eskalaci napětí kolem Hormuzského průlivu a intenzivní snahy o řešení patové situace na izraelské politické scéně.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, further escalation of tensions around the Strait of Hormuz and intense efforts to resolve the political deadlock in Israel are expected.
